one_line: Anthropic targets a massive IPO valuation, while Nvidia faces ongoing leadership scrutiny, export policy clashes, and chip smuggling investigations.

themes.title: Anthropic targets $1.4T valuation in IPO
themes.text: Anthropic is targeting a $90.4 billion raise through an IPO and private placement, aiming for a fully diluted valuation of about $1.4 trillion while maintaining its public benefit corporation status.

themes.title: Nvidia faces leadership scrutiny and trade policy clashes
themes.text: U.S. officials clash over export curbs and demand answers from Nvidia following leadership changes, investigations into illicit chip sales to China, and a chip smuggling case. Meanwhile, the Trump administration plans to designate major AI firms as national champions.

themes.text: Alibaba released the Qwen4-Max flagship model with a 1-million-token context window, and OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra assisted in creating a detailed proof for a lattice definition of the Standard Model.
